name: GaussianFlow
aliases: GaussianFlow — A method using an explicit flow field for temporal regularization in dynamic scenes.
definition: A method using an explicit flow field for temporal regularization in dynamic scenes.
summary: GaussianFlow is a dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting method that uses an explicit 3D velocity field for temporal regularization, distinguishing itself from rigid constraints by integrating flow over time for 4D reconstruction.
